entries.title: Continuous Wraparound Corner Window Wall
entries.description: One newly authored whole L-shaped village wall with a single continuous unglazed opening that wraps the right-angle building corner. The lower wall and upper return lintel remain continuous around the corner, while no intermediate corner post divides the aperture. Two full-height end piers connect the complete lower and upper wall returns into one closed editable material solid. The window sill and soffit are actual thick revealed surfaces, not a cut painted onto a solid wall. Unlike the existing solid L-wall and straight single-face window, this opening continues around the actual corner; unlike a three-face display bay it has no intermediate corner mullions or enclosed display platform. Native metres, bounds-centred ground datum, one96triangle mesh and two opaque constant PBR materials. One architecture model, zero scenes. No glass, sash, door, host house, removable cutaway, structural reinforcement design, real beam capacity, building-code compliance, installation or safety assurance. The post-free corner is a fixed game-art shape, not a claim of safe real construction.

entries.title: Fixed Twin-Helical-Drum Inspection Robot
entries.description: One newly authored complete static inspection-robot appearance. Two long parallel opposite-handed drums each have a thick core, integral continuous helical crest, tapered ends and solid journals in one closed shared-vertex surface. Two whole inverted-U end-bearing arches connect the four journal end caps to a low chamfered bridge housing; a fully backed opaque front visor completes the whole robot. The centre below the bridge and the spaces between the drums and housing stay genuinely open. Six closed editable meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR materials. New whole numerical shapes throughout: no old rover chassis with changed wheels, no old soil-auger ribbons or screw-press spindle reused, no extracted ROV body or pipe-inspector components. Opposite handed drums belong to this one prop, not two variants. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, whole horizontal envelope-centred origin with the actual lowest drum-crest vertices at ground level. Static visual genre only: no screw propulsion, rotation, traction, ground adaptation, water travel, pipe fit, sensing, autonomy, controls, working bearings, animation, load, stability, manufacture, installation, engineering or safety performance claim. No real robot construction or operating instructions.

entries.title: Static Canard Wingtip-Fin Pusher Airplane
entries.description: One newly authored complete static canard-layout land airplane exterior. The short pointed forebody broadens into a high cockpit crown and tapers directly into the rear engine body, with opaque canopy facets integral to that one surface. A full narrow forward canard precedes a separate broad swept rear main wing; two tall wingtip fins replace the conventional central aft tail and horizontal tailplane. A fixed rear two-blade propeller and complete hub sit behind the fuselage. Two splayed main gear legs and one forward leg join three flat-ground faceted tyres and complete axles. Entire new profiles, not moved old wing meshes, wheel-count change, recolour or scaled conventional plane, T-tail sailplane or stepped-hull flying boat. Sixteen closed named editable components, four constant opaque untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up, front minus Y and whole horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One vehicle prop, zero scene. No internal cockpit, moving controls, flight, thrust, aerodynamic stability, centre of gravity, gear actuation, braking, compatible ground equipment, manufacture or airworthiness/safety claim.

entries.title: Armless Quarter-Corner Sofa Module
entries.description: One original complete armless quarter-corner sofa module. A full quarter-disc foundation and softly stepped sector cushion sit above a recessed quarter plinth; one continuous padded annular back curves through ninety degrees around the outer seat boundary. Its two radial open sides define only this standalone geometric family, not a snap or dimensional compatibility claim with older sofas. Newly authored curved corner geometry, not an extracted or resized straight two-seat sofa, nor a shortened concave L dining banquette. Static furniture appearance only: no comfort, load, stability, upholstery simulation, fastening or installation guarantee.

entries.title: Sorting Table and Cubbies Room
entries.description: One static postal sorting preparation room, one scene and zero new independent models. A complete six-cell sorting cabinet stands at the rear, facing a separate complete open worktable. One unchanged open-front notched letter tray and one whole divided open mail satchel rest side by side on the actual finite tabletop, with a clear gap between them. The table retains its complete open knee space and bracing. A closed scene-only floor leaves a front approach and two side passages. Four whole original models preserve raw GLB mesh and normal payloads, internal node transforms, all triangles and per-face PBR at original unit scale. This is a table-to-rear-cubby preparation layout, not the older street letterbox and parcel-filled cabinet corner with relabelled goods. No letters, parcels, sorting mechanism, delivery process, working weighing equipment, load capacity, reach or accessibility compliance, operational or installation safety is claimed.

entries.title: Fixed Guided Bifold Door Kit
entries.description: One original complete fixed folded two-leaf interior doorway kit: a freestanding square-headed frame encloses a true passage, two thick recessed-panel leaves fold toward the front around a side pivot and a central vertical hinge, while the free upper end meets a real slotted top channel with a fixed stem and captive head. Visible hinge straps join each leaf to its barrels; a single pull belongs to the free leaf. New complete assembly, not old single leaves duplicated or the freestanding three-panel education display renamed. One fixed pose only: no opening animation, continuous clearance, load, installation, accessibility or old-wall compatibility certification.

entries.title: Complete Raised Monitor Roof Shell
entries.description: One newly authored complete village raised-monitor roof shell. Two full lower inclined roof flanks connect continuously into a raised central longitudinal strip, whose two opposite side walls each contain one genuine long unglazed aperture. A complete upper two-pitch cap joins those walls and both thick end returns, so no upper roof floats independently. The entire material boundary is one closed connected editable mesh, including both lower flanks, aperture reveals, ends, upper cap and exposed underside; internal cell faces are omitted. Unlike the old front-window dormer, the complete main roof is included and the openings run lengthwise on both sides of the raised ridge strip. This is not an old dormer placed atop an old roof, a recolour or changed pitch/count of repeated old pieces. Native metres, XYbounds-centred lowest-eave datum, one276triangle mesh and two opaque constant PBR materials. One architecture model, zero scenes. No glazing, louvers, host walls, hidden render cutaway, airflow/daylight performance, weather sealing, drainage, load, old-host compatibility, installation or safety guarantee. Lowest eave edges define the preview datum, not a flat freestanding foundation.

entries.title: Scale Desk and Pickup Locker Hall
entries.description: One static postal service and pickup hall scene, zero new models. A complete open worktable on the left carries the original whole tabletop parcel scale at its documented unit-scale table height. A separate complete four-compartment pickup locker sits to the right and rear, preserving all four original doors, its one fixed-open lower door, eight real bored hinge pairs and all original hardware. A closed scene-only floor and central approach band distinguish the counter-side preparation position from the independent locker-front zone. Three complete old models preserve raw mesh/normal payloads, internal transforms, original fixed poses and every per-face PBR. The broad front approach and gap between the complete desk and locker are unoccupied. Different from the mailbox/cubby street corner and the table-to-rear-cubby sorting room; no copied scene relabelled as a hall. No parcels, credentials, readable display, weighing, transactions, collection service, locks or security, door movement, capacity, ergonomic or accessibility compliance, installation or public-safety certification is claimed.

entries.title: Fixed Crosshead Crank and Flywheel Bench
entries.description: One newly authored complete static steam-workshop drive-bench display: a grounded continuous base supports an open-top horizontal cylinder with visible separate piston, real bored front gland and a rod reaching a crosshead block between two full guides. One complete inclined two-eye connecting rod is retained on the crosshead pin and an actual offset crank pin. A separate crank disk, full shaft, two bored bearing pedestals and one full open-spoke flywheel complete the new assembly. All geometry is freshly authored, not a scene containing old cylinder/rod/gear props, not a resized cutaway cylinder or extra copied gear. The flywheel has a complete annular rim and six whole radial spokes around a hub, with real open spaces. Metres, native Z up, horizontal-bounds-centred grounded origin, three opaque solid untextured PBR materials and individually editable closed components. One complete prop, zero scene. One fixed illustrative pose only: no steam, pressure, cycle timing, torque, power, force transmission, working bearing fit, travel envelope, full-stroke collision clearance, rigging, animation, efficiency, load, stability, manufacture or safety claim.

entries.title: Wide Undercut Rock Cliff Shelter
entries.description: One original complete wide undercut natural cliff terrain module. A full-width grounded irregular rear cliff connects through a shallow foot terrace to a heavy projecting angular rock roof, making a broad shaded C-section recess open at the front and both lateral ends. The unequal thick roof profile and uneven broad back are one closed continuous shared-vertex rock body, not a stack of independent slabs, central-pillar caprock, two-foot through arch or low small-mouth mound. All five full new slices and their connecting faces are authored here; no previous cliff, ravine, bridge, failed caprock or burrow geometry imported or hidden. Three opaque matte mineral roles, no texture or decor. One terrain module, zero scenes; the roof, wall and terrace are not separate assets. Metres, Z up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Cut lateral outlines are explicit module boundaries; no compatibility with other cliff modules promised. Static stylised natural appearance only, no geology, erosion, navigability, usable shelter, stability, climbing or real-world safety claim.
